message.name: MDHK_STATUS
message.description: ZYhawk consolidated 1 Hz telemetry status. This supplements standard MAVLink messages and does not change their definitions.
message.field: Timestamp since system boot.
GPS UTC Gregorian year. Zero means invalid.
GPS UTC month, 1 through 12. Zero means invalid.
GPS UTC day, 1 through 31. Zero means invalid.
GPS UTC hour in 24-hour format, 0 through 23.
GPS UTC minute, 0 through 59.
GPS UTC second, 0 through 60.
Validity bitmap for the grouped values in this packet. The vendor enum is preserved as a raw value until its bit definitions are supplied.
Raw GPS latitude.
Raw GPS longitude.
Raw GPS altitude above mean sea level.
Estimated altitude relative to HOME, positive upward.
Available system memory.
Firmware version encoded as in AUTOPILOT_VERSION.flight_sw_version.
Horizontal distance from the aircraft to the current navigation waypoint.
Maximum EKF compass variance.
Magnitude of compass instance 1 field vector.
Magnitude of compass instance 2 field vector.
Primary battery cell voltages 1 through 4. UINT16_MAX means invalid.
Primary smart-battery cycle count. UINT16_MAX means invalid.
Difference between the highest and lowest valid primary-battery cell voltage. UINT16_MAX means invalid.
Flags encoded as in EKF_STATUS_REPORT.flags.
Current mission sequence number.
Total mission item count excluding HOME.
Primary battery current. -1 means invalid.
Primary battery temperature. INT16_MAX means invalid.
Primary battery remaining percentage. -1 means invalid.
Raw GPS fix type.
Number of satellites visible. 255 means invalid.
MDHK_STATUS payload schema version.
Final logical red LED output, 0 through 255.
Final logical green LED output, 0 through 255.
Final logical blue LED output, 0 through 255.
Firmware Git/custom version bytes.
Twenty-character Base32 STM32 hardware identifier.
